## Overview

This notebook reproduces the analyses reported for an in-prep paper.

Analyses:
1. Fixation counts: whether instruction condition changes how often children look at each area of interest (AOI).
2. Transitions: whether condition changes how children move their gaze between AOIs.
3. Refixations: whether condition changes how often children look back at the same AOI.
4. Machine learning: whether classifiers trained on transition patterns can recover instruction condition better than a random A/B baseline.

AOIs: All problems had 5 AOIs labeled left to right (A + B + C = D + E). 

Data availability: Participant data are not included in this repository.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(broom)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(methods)
#library(easystats)
library(caret)
library(readr)       # for importing data
library(car)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load-data}

```



## Fixation counts by AOI

Do children in the two instruction conditions look at each part of the problem a different number of times? Fixation counts per AOI are modeled with linear mixed-effects models (random intercepts for participant and problem), controlling for log problem duration and correctness.
### Fixation counts by condition
```{r count-plot}
FinalData %>% 
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% #Bad tracks
  filter(ProblemTime == "PAO") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "PostTest") %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProbCorrAdj, Condition, TestTime, ProblemNumber, Matching, BlankLocation, ProbDuration, Addend) %>%
  summarize(FixationNum = n()) %>%
  mutate(ProbDuration = log(ProbDuration)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Addend, values_from = FixationNum, values_fill=0) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), names_to = "Addend", values_to = "Count") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Addend, y=Count, color=Condition)) +
    stat_summary(geom="pointrange") +
    labs(x = "Addend Location", y = "Fixation Count", color = "Instructional Condition") + 
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") 


```

### Mixed-effects models

A model with an AOI × condition interaction is compared against a model without condition, and condition differences are then tested within each AOI.


```{r count-model}
COUNTAnalysis = FinalData %>% 
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% #Bad tracks
  filter(ProblemTime == "PAO") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "PostTest") %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProbCorrAdj, Condition, TestTime, ProblemNumber, Matching, BlankLocation, ProbDuration, Addend) %>%
  summarize(FixationNum = n()) %>%
  mutate(ProbDuration = log(ProbDuration)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Addend, values_from = FixationNum, values_fill=0) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), names_to = "Addend", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(ProbCorrAdj = as.factor(as.character(ProbCorrAdj))) %>%
  mutate(Condition = as.factor(Condition)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.character(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  lmer(Count ~ ProbDuration + ProbCorrAdj + Addend*Condition + 
          (1| ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .)
summary(COUNTAnalysis)
```

## Transition data setup

Fixations are converted into transitions between consecutive AOIs (e.g., `AB` = a look from A directly to B), counted per participant and problem, and reshaped for plotting and modeling. A second version recodes transitions relative to the blank's position (`Blank` = the blank's AOI, `RA` = the other right-side AOI).


```{r build-transitions}
FinalData.Filtered = FinalData %>%    
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>%
  filter(ProblemTime == "PAO") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "PostTest")

FinalData.AOITrans = FinalData.Filtered %>%
  mutate(AOITrans = paste0(Addend,lead(Addend))) %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, TestTime, ProblemTime, BlankLocation, Matching, ProblemNumber, ProbDuration,SubjectGender, Condition, ProbCorrAdj, AOITrans) %>%
  summarize(Count = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = AOITrans, values_from = Count, values_fill=0) %>%
  ungroup()
  
FinalData.AOITrans = FinalData.AOITrans[,-36]
```


```{r blank-coding}
FinalData.Blank = FinalData.AOITrans %>%
  mutate('ABlank' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ AD,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ AE)) %>%
  mutate('BBlank' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ BD,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ BE)) %>%
  mutate('CBlank' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ CD,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ CE)) %>%
  mutate('BlankBlank' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ DD,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ EE)) %>%
  mutate('RABlank' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ ED,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ DE)) %>%
  mutate('BlankA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ DA,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ EA)) %>%
  mutate('BlankB' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ DB,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ EB)) %>%
  mutate('BlankC' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ DC,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ EC)) %>%
  mutate('BlankRA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ DE,
                              BlankLocation == "RB" ~ ED)) %>%
  mutate('ARA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ AE,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ AD)) %>%
  mutate('BRA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ BE,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ BD)) %>%
  mutate('CRA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ CE,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ CD)) %>%
  mutate('RARA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ EE,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ DD)) %>%
  mutate('RAA' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ EA,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ DA)) %>%
  mutate('RAB' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ EB,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ DB)) %>%
  mutate('RAC' = case_when(BlankLocation == "LB" ~ EC,
                           BlankLocation == "RB" ~ DC)) %>%
  select(-c(AD, AE, BD, BE, CD, CE, DD, DE, EE, ED, DA, DB, DC, EA, EB, EC))

```

```{r blank-transitions-long}
FinalData.BlankTrans.Longer = FinalData.Blank %>%
  pivot_longer(.,cols = c("AA", "AB", "AC", "ABlank", "ARA",
                          "BA","BB","BC","BBlank", "BRA",
                          "CA","CB","CC","CBlank","CRA",
                          "BlankA","BlankB","BlankC","BlankBlank","BlankRA",
                          "RAA","RAB","RAC","RABlank","RARA"),
               names_to = "TransitionAddends", values_to = "TransitionCount") %>%
  mutate(., StartingAddend = case_when(substr(TransitionAddends, 0,2) == "Bl" ~ 'Blank',
                                       substr(TransitionAddends, 0,2) == "RA" ~ "RA",
                                       substr(TransitionAddends, 0,1) == "A" ~ "A",
                                       substr(TransitionAddends, 0,1) == "C" ~ "C",
                                       substr(TransitionAddends, 0,1) == "B" & substr(TransitionAddends, 0,2) != "Bl" ~ "B"))
```


```{r transitions-long}
FinalData.AOITrans.Longer = FinalData.AOITrans %>%
  pivot_longer(.,cols = c("AA", "AB", "AC", "AD", "AE",
                          "BA","BB","BC","BD", "BE",
                          "CA","CB","CC","CD","CE",
                          "DA","DB","DC","DD","DE",
                          "EA","EB","EC","ED","EE"),
               names_to = "TransitionAddends", values_to = "TransitionCount") %>%
  mutate(., StartingAddend = substr(TransitionAddends, 0,1))
```



## Transitions between AOIs

For each starting AOI, a mixed-effects model tests whether transition counts to each destination differ by condition, compared against a model without condition.


### Transition counts by starting AOI

```{r transition-plot-all}
FinalData.AOITrans.Longer %>% 
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% #Bad tracks
  filter(TestTime == "PostTest") %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProblemNumber) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=TransitionAddends, y=TransitionCount, color=Condition)) +
    stat_summary(geom="pointrange") +
    facet_grid(~StartingAddend, scales="free")
```





### Transition counts by condition


```{r transition-plot-by-destination}
FinalData.AOITrans.Longer %>% 
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% 
  filter(TestTime == "PostTest") %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProblemNumber) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TransitionAddends, y = TransitionCount, color = Condition)) +
    stat_summary(geom = "pointrange", fun.data = mean_se) + # Added fun.data to stop the warning
    facet_grid(~StartingAddend, scales = "free") + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) substr(x, 2, 2)) + 
    # 1. Native ggplot2 way to add a secondary top axis title
    guides(x.sec = guide_axis(title = "Initial Fixation Location", position = "top")) + 
    # 2. Hide the duplicated text labels and ticks from the top axis
    theme(
      axis.text.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank()
    )+ 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = "Final Fixation Location", y = "Average Transition Count", Color = "Instruction Type")



```

### Transitions starting at A

```{r trans-a-model}
TransCountModel.AAddend = FinalData.AOITrans.Longer %>%
  drop_na(ProbCorrAdj) %>%
  filter(StartingAddend == "A") %>%
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% #Bad tracks
  lmer(TransitionCount ~  scale(ProbDuration) + TransitionAddends*Condition + 
          (1| ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .)
summary(TransCountModel.AAddend)
```

```{r trans-a-model-no-condition}
TransCountModel.AAddend.NoCon = FinalData.AOITrans.Longer %>%
  drop_na(ProbCorrAdj) %>%
  filter(StartingAddend == "A") %>%
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% #Bad tracks
  lmer(TransitionCount ~  scale(ProbDuration) + TransitionAddends + 
          (1| ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .)
summary(TransCountModel.AAddend.NoCon)
```

```{r trans-a-comparison}
anova(TransCountModel.AAddend.NoCon,TransCountModel.AAddend)
```


```{r trans-a-emmeans}
emmeans(TransCountModel.AAddend, pairwise ~ Condition | TransitionAddends, pbkrtest.limit = 5000)
```
Condition differences appear only for `AA` and `AB` transitions.

## Refixations


Do children refixate the same AOI more often after gesture instruction than after speech-only instruction? Refixations (`AA`, `BB`, `CC`, `DD`, `EE`) are compared with transitions that move to a different AOI.
```{r refixation-means}

as.data.frame(FinalData.AOITrans.Longer) %>%
  mutate(Refixation = case_when(TransitionAddends == "AA" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "BB" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "CC" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "DD" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "EE" ~ 1,
                                TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
  filter(Refixation == 1) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarize(meanRefixation = mean(TransitionCount))



as.data.frame(FinalData.AOITrans.Longer) %>%
  mutate(Refixation = case_when(TransitionAddends == "AA" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "BB" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "CC" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "DD" ~ 1,
                                TransitionAddends == "EE" ~ 1,
                                TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
  filter(Refixation == 0) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarize(meanMoveFixation = mean(TransitionCount))

```

## Machine learning results

Model performance is loaded from the saved results of the classification notebook (64 repetitions per model). 
### Condition models
#### Test accuracy vs. chance (50%)
```{r ttest-condition-only}
TtestList.Con = AllModels %>%
```

### Condition models vs. A/B baseline
Two-sample t-tests comparing the condition model against the A/B baseline on each metric.
```{r compare-test-accuracy}

  filter(ModelParameters == "Condition Only" | ModelParameters == "A or B + Features") %>%
  t.test(TestAccuracy ~ ModelParameters, data = .)
```


The condition models performed well above the A/B baseline on every metric.


## Figures

### Transition counts (blank-relative coding)


```{r paper-transition-figure}
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.2)

# Define a named vector to map your data levels to the new display names
facet_names <- c(
  "A"     = "A",
  "B"     = "B",
  "C"     = "C",
  "RA"    = "Right-side Addend", # Updates your target label
  "Blank" = "Blank"
)

FinalData.BlankTrans.Longer %>% 
  filter(ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED" & ParticipantID != "REDACTED") %>% 
  filter(TestTime == "PostTest") %>%
  mutate(StartingAddend = factor(StartingAddend, ordered = TRUE, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "RA", "Blank"))) %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProblemNumber) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("^Bl", TransitionAddends)     ~ substr(TransitionAddends, 6, 10), 
        grepl("^[ABC]", TransitionAddends)  ~ substr(TransitionAddends, 2, 10), 
        grepl("^R", TransitionAddends)      ~ substr(TransitionAddends, 3, 10), 
        TRUE                                ~ TransitionAddends
      ),
      levels = c("A", "B", "C", "RA", "Blank")
    ), 
    y = TransitionCount, 
    color = Condition
  )) +
    stat_summary(geom = "pointrange", fun.data = mean_se, position = pd) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    
    guides(x.sec = guide_axis(title = "Initial Fixation Location", position = "top")) + 
    theme(
      axis.text.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom" # Combined your theme tweaks into a single block
    ) + 
    
    # Applied the custom name map via the labeller argument
    facet_wrap(~StartingAddend, scales = "free_x", labeller = as_labeller(facet_names)) + 
    
    labs(x = "Final Fixation Location", y = "Mean Transition Count", color = "Instruction Type")

```





### Model performance
#### Condition models
```{r condition-performance-figure}
AllModels %>%
  filter(ModelType == "Condition Model") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("TestAccuracy", "F1Score", "Precision"), values_to = "MeanPerformance", names_to = "TestingMetric") %>%
  mutate(ModelParameters = case_when(ModelParameters == "Condition Only" ~ "Visual Transition Probabilities",
                                     ModelParameters == "Condition + Features" ~ "Probabilties + Features",
                                     ModelParameters == "Condition + Number" ~ "Probabilities + Problem ID",
                                     ModelParameters == "Condition + Number + Features" ~ "Probabilities + Features + ID"
    
  )) %>%
  mutate(TestingMetric = case_when(
    TestingMetric == "TestAccuracy" ~ "Accuracy",
    TestingMetric == "F1Score" ~ "F1",
    TRUE ~ TestingMetric
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ModelParameters, y=MeanPerformance)) + 
  stat_summary(aes(color=ModelParameters), geom="pointrange") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(.25,.75)) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") + 
  labs(x = "Model Paramaters", y = "Mean Testing Accuracy", color = "Model Parameters") +
  facet_wrap(~TestingMetric)

```
